P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image is present anywhere on the page; it is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: There is no client portrait or named person image at any size; the case study section contains only body text.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus—no logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials—appears on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements such as giant ghost numerals or large quote glyphs are present.

P11.rationale: Numbers are mentioned in the body copy (e.g., 200,000 Euro, 99 Prozent) but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or data visualisations binding those figures.

P12.rationale: The page is extremely sparse, with two short text blocks occupying only the top quarter and the remaining three-quarters completely empty.

P13.rationale: The page has a very subtle warm off-white/cream background tone rather than pure white, providing minimal atmospheric texture but nothing intentional or designed.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable; scored 0 as the device is absent.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book, etc.) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: There are no images at all, so stock imagery is not an issue, but the complete absence of visuals makes the page feel generic by default.

N08.rationale: Roughly 70–75% of the page area below the two text blocks is completely empty, representing severe purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There are no photos on the page, so text-over-busy-photo issues do not arise.
